## Standing operator rules
- “Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “run the procedure 'avatar-cdn-batched-migration' in between your other work. Goal: Copy local avatar files to the production CDN and update user avatar URLs in verified database batches. Run these steps in order, one at a time.”
- “Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Current objective
Fix the Stripe webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer HTTP 400 responses. Invoice-PDF performance work is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Webhook target: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- Integration runner: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded because it is being retired and jobs there hang.
- Avatar source/manifest: `/srv/app/avatars`, `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; 18,432 files.
- Avatar destination: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`.
- SQLAlchemy files: `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/models.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, `tests/conftest.py`.
- Do not add invoice `(customer_id, created_at)` index; it doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
- [in progress] Diagnose and fix Stripe signature verification, with exact output posted.
- [pending] Run focused webhook tests, then broader relevant tests and a small commit.
- [pending] Avatar migration step 6 command: status unknown/not supplied; steps 7–8 must follow one at a time.
- [paused] Pagination release notes, staging smoke test, and commit.
- [done] Avatar steps 1–5: database run creation, manifest, CDN sync, and object verification.
- [in progress] SQLAlchemy 2.0 cleanup: baseline passed; `ledgerly/models.py` declarative-base migration edited, validation pending.

## Recent work
Invoice PDF fixes passed focused, full PDF, and billing suites, but are paused. Full-suite baseline was `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Inspection found `make_engine()` still passes removed SQLAlchemy 2.0 option `echo=True`; `ledgerly/models.py` was then migrated to `DeclarativeBase`. No webhook diagnosis has yet been performed.
